directPostAudit.reasonSource: Authenticated TikTok Developer Portal app detail response
directPostAudit.reason: The demo did not show all Required UX Implementation points 1-5, the complete end-to-end flow ending with the resulting post in TikTok, and the full website URL.

evidenceGap.requiredRepair: Record a replacement demo that visibly covers UX points 1-5, keeps the full AIRDOX URL visible, completes OAuth and publishing, and ends with the resulting post visible in TikTok.

requiredBeforeReapplication: Produce and review the replacement demo against the recording gate.
Confirm that the demo ends with the resulting post visible inside TikTok.
Obtain separate user confirmation immediately before submitting the external reapplication.
requiredAfterAuditApproval: Run direct-post OAuth and store a new refresh token containing video.publish.
Run npm run social:tiktok:check:init and require posting_init_ready_no_media_uploaded.
Keep per-video approval for video, caption, privacy, platform, timing, and landing URL.
